<EnterpriseFeature>
  <EnterpriseFeatureContent>
    <EnterpriseFeatureTitle>Ship better software, faster</EnterpriseFeatureTitle>
    <EnterpriseFeatureDescription>
      Cursor helps your entire team deliver ambitious products.
    </EnterpriseFeatureDescription>
    <EnterpriseFeatureTestimonial 
      quote="I've never, as a CTO, received so many texts or Slack messages from employees just saying 'Thank you for getting this technology here.'"
      author="Melody Hildebrandt"
      role="CTO, Fox"
      avatar="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/photo-1573496359142-b8d87734a5a2_wrmb8d.jpg"
    />
  </EnterpriseFeatureContent>
  <EnterpriseFeatureMedia backgroundSrc="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/enterpirse-bg-1_jycoz2.png"
    windowSrc="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/Ship_better_software_faster_kiufyg.png"
    alt="Cursor Enterprise helping teams ship better software faster"
  />
</EnterpriseFeature>

<EnterpriseFeature reverse>
  <EnterpriseFeatureContent>
    <EnterpriseFeatureTitle>Your engineering knowledge base</EnterpriseFeatureTitle>
    <EnterpriseFeatureDescription>
      Architected for complex codebases
built by thousands of developers.
    </EnterpriseFeatureDescription>
    <EnterpriseFeatureTestimonial 
      quote="Across roles and levels, we're seeing an increase of over 25% in PR volume and over 100% in the average PR size. Together, that means we're shipping about 50% more code."
      author="Anton Andreev"
      role="Principal Software Engineer, Upwork"
      avatar="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/photo-1519085360753-af0119f7cbe7_wfqevv.jpg"
    />
  </EnterpriseFeatureContent>
  <EnterpriseFeatureMedia backgroundSrc="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/enterprise-bg_xyfewz.png"
    windowSrc="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/Your_engineering_knowledge_base_rlayo8.png"
    alt="Cursor engineering knowledge base for complex codebases"
  />
</EnterpriseFeature>

<EnterpriseFeature>
  <EnterpriseFeatureContent>
    <EnterpriseFeatureTitle>Loved by developers</EnterpriseFeatureTitle>
    <EnterpriseFeatureDescription>
      In head-to-head evaluations, 93% of engineers select Cursor as their preferred AI coding tool.
    </EnterpriseFeatureDescription>
    <EnterpriseFeatureTestimonial 
      quote="What used to be a weeks-long ramp-up, navigating complex repos and scheduling handoffs across global teams, is now a structured process built around Cursor from day one."
      author="Roni Avidov"
      role="Senior R&D Team Lead, Monday"
      avatar="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d_n3hgss.jpg"
    />
  </EnterpriseFeatureContent>
  <EnterpriseFeatureMedia backgroundSrc="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/hero-feature-bg_cv6a3i.png"
    windowSrc="https://tnxdfwwsvqp8lylo.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/Loved_by_developers_zo7ffg.png"
    alt="Cursor loved by developers with 93 percent preference rate"
  />
</EnterpriseFeature>

  <ChangelogCard href="/changelog/2.3">

<FAQ className="bg-card" title="Questions & Answers">
  <FAQItem question="How do usage limits work for enterprises?">
    Enterprise plans come with custom usage limits tailored to your team's needs. We offer flexible scaling options to ensure your developers always have access to the models and features they need without interruption.
  </FAQItem>
  <FAQItem question="How does Cursor handle large-scale codebases and monorepos?">
    Cursor is architected specifically for scale. Our indexing system handles millions of lines of code across complex monorepos, providing instant, context-aware answers and completions regardless of project size.
  </FAQItem>
  <FAQItem question="How does Cursor use my data?">
    Your code is yours. On Enterprise plans, we offer a zero-retention policy—nothing you write or index is used to train our models or those of our providers. Everything is handled with the highest level of privacy and security.
  </FAQItem>
  <FAQItem question="What security certifications does Cursor have?">
    Cursor is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and undergoes annual third-party penetration testing. We comply with GDPR, CCPA, and architectural best practices for enterprise security.
  </FAQItem>
  <FAQItem question="Does Cursor support SSO and SCIM?">
    Yes. We support SAML-based SSO integration (including Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace) and SCIM for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning.
  </FAQItem>
  <FAQItem question="Does Cursor support on-premises or VPC deployment?">
    We offer flexible deployment options for enterprises, including virtual private clouds and highly secure gateway configurations to meet your infrastructure requirements.
  </FAQItem>
  <FAQItem question="What admin controls are available?">
    Admins have full visibility and control over model access, billing groups, service accounts, and system-level agent rules across the entire organization.
  </FAQItem>
  <FAQItem question="How can I track AI adoption across my organization?">
    Our Enterprise dashboard provides detailed insights into tool usage, seat allocation, and productivity metrics, helping you measure the impact of AI on your development flow.
  </FAQItem>
</FAQ>
